# Companion code — MES-transition switch in IDH-wildtype glioblastoma (Paper 2)
#
# Versions recorded from the authors' analysis environment (September 2026), i.e.
# the versions the analyses were actually run with. This is a version record, not
# a frozen lockfile: the original virtualenv is no longer available, so reproduce
# with these pins where possible and loosen them only if your platform requires it.
#
#   python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
#   pip install -r env/requirements.txt
#
# Python 3.12 was used throughout.

# --- core single-cell stack ---
scanpy==1.12.3
anndata==0.13.2
numpy==2.3.5
scipy==1.16.3
pandas==2.3.3
leidenalg==0.12.0
igraph==1.0.0

# --- cohort processing / integration ---
harmonypy==2.0.0
scrublet==0.2.3
scvi-tools==1.5.0.post1
scvelo==0.3.4
infercnvpy==0.6.1
gtfparse                       # GTF annotation parsing used by 02_integration_infercnv.py

# --- regulon / TF-activity inference (prior-based) ---
decoupler==2.2.0               # DoRothEA regulons, MLM

# --- clinical survival analysis ---
lifelines==0.30.3
statsmodels>=0.14

# --- plotting / tables ---
matplotlib==3.11.1
seaborn==0.13.2

# --- Notes on packages NOT used by the released scripts ---
# The paper additionally reports de-novo pySCENIC regulon inference and NicheNet
# ligand-target modelling. Those analyses are not part of this release (see README
# "What is not included"), so pyscenic / arboreto / loompy / nichenetr are
# deliberately not pinned here.
